name: Kodo Horn
summary: Across the Barrens, Kodo Horns are gathered for Tonga Runetotem's remedies. He uses them to treat poisoned wildlife.

sections.title: A Reagent of the Plains
sections.body: Across the Barrens, Tonga Runetotem uses whole kodo horns in his herbal remedies. He works from the Crossroads, where the horns strengthen his salves. Chips and fragments lack the strength he needs, so he gathers intact horns from mature kodos roaming the plains.

faq.q: What are Kodo Horns used for?
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem brews a salve with Kodo Horns, Earthroot, and pure water to treat poisoned gazelles across the Barrens. The remedy teaches a druid how to cure poison with nature's aid.
You can gather Kodo Horns from Barrens Kodos and Lost Barrens Kodos in the northern Barrens, between the Crossroads and the surrounding scrubland.

faq.q: Why can't druids use horn fragments instead?
faq.answer: Tonga Runetotem says chips and fragments lack the potency to balance the salve. He needs intact horns for a remedy strong enough to counter virulent toxins.

faq.q: Is hunting kodos considered respectful for a druid?
faq.answer: Yes. Druids hunt kodos to serve nature's balance, taking what they need to heal greater blights, such as the mysterious poisoning afflicting the native gazelle herds.

angles.text: As a Horde druid, you gather horns under Tonga Runetotem's guidance while learning to master nature's poisons.
As a tauren, you hold kodos in high reverence. You take from them with care and purpose to safeguard the Barrens' delicate ecosystem.
